convert_md_to_mdx: convert markdown documentation text to Svelte-based MDX format with package metadata
clean_runnable_blocks: clean runnable code blocks by stripping annotations and removing hidden lines
convert_img_links: convert relative image links to full HuggingFace docs URLs for a given package and version
convert_include: include file content into markdown based on path and optional start-after/end-before markers
convert_literalinclude: include source code file content as a fenced code block with optional language and line markers
